rows.note: This is the all-purpose term for someone holding the professor rank at a university.

example.english: That professor will teach us next semester.
example.traditional: 嗰位教授下個學期會教我哋。
example.jyutping: go2 wai2 gaau3 sau6 haa6 go3 hok6 kei4 wui5 gaau3 ngo5 dei6

rows.note: Use this broader term for a university teacher or faculty member who may not hold the formal professor rank.

example.english: My older brother is a university professor who specializes in teaching history.
example.traditional: 我阿哥係大學老師，專門教歷史。
example.jyutping: ngo5 aa3 go1 hai6 daai6 hok6 lou5 si1 zyun1 mun4 gaau3 lik6 si2
